sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: Cardano Builder DAO treasury withdrawal to operate and scale a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.
Recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal received and administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.

Deliverables: Allocate capital to builders intended to improve Cardano ecosystem KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL., Continue development of public and increasingly on-chain KPI tracking for funded projects., Run proposal evaluation, feedback coordination, fund distribution, and results tracking through a smart contract-governed DAO process., Disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.

Claim (adoption, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The proposal says Cardano Builder DAO is a smart contract-governed funding mechanism designed to allocate capital to builders advancing Vision 2030 KPIs such as MAU, monthly transactions, and TVL.

Claim (technical, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposer claims the DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported KPI tracking toward tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions as core KPIs.
Claim (economic, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposer claims Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, medium materiality): The proposal states Round 1 included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a transparent smart contract-governed process.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, medium materiality): The proposal states Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

Independent evidence for: The proposer claims Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

model_layer.note: Claim extraction and the plain-language message are model-assisted, advisory layers. The hard gates (stale data, missing evidence, treasury-needs-dossier, hard blockers, high flags) are deterministic and binding. The doctrine-aware reasoning layer records a bounded advisory lean of at most ±0.05, but it is not added to the binding score and cannot change the vote.
